## 1. Purpose and boundary

Help implementers understand how twelve document types work together. This starter supplies one original demonstration of each type around reporting a concern, agreeing an action and assessing its result. It is not the full P01–P23 process library, twelve planned internal standards or a complete ISO implementation pack. No standard clauses, publisher tables or complete normative requirement lists are reproduced.

## 2. Architecture and governance

Use Objective → Risk → Control → Assurance (ORCA), with prior-use attribution in [SOURCES](../../SOURCES.md). An objective states the intended result; the risk describes what can prevent it; a control is a specific role/action/trigger/method with evidence; assurance examines whether the control and its result meet the scoped criterion. An action to build a control is not automatically the control itself.

The project's four fundamentals, ten elements, twelve planned standards, four deployment layers and P01–P23 identities remain unchanged design directions. This starter neither supplies their full specifications nor renames them. Organization, site and job configurations must be created and approved separately.

## 3. Document interactions

Read the policy and original internal standard before tailoring the process. The procedure provides the sequence; the instruction focuses on reviewing closure evidence; the plan schedules adoption. The form collects a concern; the register tracks it. The fictional record demonstrates a held action; the assurance protocol defines a test; the example report states its limited conclusion. [Library navigation](README.md) links every master.

## 4. Applicability, configuration and assurance

Define actual scope, roles, urgency routes, applicable obligations, technical criteria, records protection and review competence before use. Generic document guidance cannot supply plant repair instructions or jurisdiction-specific duties. Unknown prerequisites hold dependent decisions; escalation follows the organization's actual authorized arrangements. Evaluate each control separately from action completion and overall system claims.

## 5. Sources and history

Original project teaching design from the accepted user requirements and general workflow concepts. Source standards are references, not included texts. r01: first bounded twelve-type learning starter; no organizational implementation or independent review claimed.
